title: 10 Pirate Myths You Still Believe (And What Was Real)
description:
Eye patches, parrots, walking the plank, buried treasure... how much of what we "know" about pirates is real?

We fact-check ten famous pirate "facts". Some are total myths, born in books and films like Treasure Island. Others are real, and stranger than the movies: pirates signed written rules, paid injury compensation from the shared loot, voted their captains in and out, and two of the most famous pirates of the Caribbean were women.
